claim.zh: DFM 是一套范式：把「发现」具体化为可学习、可执行、可评测的能力。
claim.en: DFM is a paradigm: discovery made learnable, executable and evaluable.

claim.zh: 科学家的追问、修改、采纳、否定与重新运行形成反馈，推动科研智能体工作环境持续演化。
claim.en: A scientist's follow-ups, edits, acceptances, rejections and re-runs become feedback, and the feedback keeps the agent's workspace evolving.

claim.zh: 把真实科学代码、任务目标与验证标准，组织成可运行、可测量、可复现的科学环境。
claim.en: Real scientific code, task goals and verification criteria, organised into runnable, measurable, reproducible environments.

claim.zh: 在行动之前，预测一个干预会把世界状态带向哪里。
claim.en: Before acting, predict where an intervention takes the world state.

claim.zh: 两条光路缺一不可：科学家的真实问题与验证条件，遇上能被检验的下一代 AI 系统。
claim.en: Two arms, one pattern: real problems and real verification meet a next-generation AI system that can be tested.

claim.zh: 官网重构：中英双语，结构化数据维护。
